Programs

Six sports. One shape-shifting coach.

Every program runs the same 8-week structure and the same Proto-led warm-up — so kids build real skill in one sport while staying curious about all the others.

AGES 5–12

Football

Dribble, pass, and score — the beautiful game, taught one small win at a time.

AGES 5–12

Basketball

Dribbling, footwork, and shooting form, built up drill by playful drill.

AGES 5–12

Tennis

Serve, volley, and rally with racquet skills scaled to smaller hands.

AGES 5–12

Swimming

Water confidence first, technique second — splashing always encouraged.

AGES 5–12

Athletics

Run, jump, and throw — personal bests are celebrated every single week.

AGES 5–12

Cricket

Bat, bowl, and field the fundamentals — teamwork included by default.

What they learn

Six values, one sticker at a time.

Every session ends with a value called out by name — and a sticker to prove it. It's how "be a good teammate" becomes something a seven-year-old can actually collect.

TEAMWORK

Stronger together, on every team.

EFFORT

Give your best every single day.

RESPECT

For yourself, others, and the game.

FOCUS

Locked in and ready for anything.

COURAGE

Brave enough to try something new.

IMPROVEMENT

Every small step leads to big change.

Progress & rewards

Every milestone gets a moment.

Certificates, a parent-facing progress tracker, and stamp-worthy praise — real recognition, not just a participation trophy.

Certificates
